about: Analyst ratings found by web research for stocks that Yahoo Finance does not cover. Maintained by a weekly scheduled task; read by build_dashboard.py. n = number of analysts found (0 = searched, none found). rating: strong_buy | buy | hold | underperform | sell | null. checked = date researched; asOf = date of the newest analyst view found.

ACL.brokers: Macquarie, Ord Minnett, Canaccord Genuity, RBC Capital
ACL.note: The shares have rallied above most broker targets; MarketScreener's consensus is Hold with an average target near A$2.95, and Macquarie was Neutral at A$2.90 in late October 2026. TradingView shows a more bullish average of about A$3.50, but MarketScreener's current figures were used.

OML.note: Several brokers moved to Hold after the August 2026 result, and the average target is roughly in line with the current price.

APA.brokers: UBS, Citi, Morgan Stanley, Morgans, Ord Minnett
APA.note: Views are split: Citi rates it Buy, while UBS, Morgans and Ord Minnett have Sell calls. The share price sits above even the highest target.

CWY.brokers: Morgans, Jefferies, UBS, Jarden, Morgan Stanley
CWY.note: Most brokers rate it Buy, with Morgan Stanley the main Hold, but the average target leaves little upside from the current price.

EVT.brokers: Morgan Stanley, Jarden, Citi, Ord Minnett
EVT.note: The brokers listed with recent actions all rate it Buy. The average target is a little above the current price.

EWC.note: No sell-side analyst coverage or price targets were found for this stock.

FPH.brokers: UBS, Jefferies, Morgan Stanley, Canaccord Genuity, Citi, Macquarie, Jarden
FPH.note: Brokers lean positive overall, but the AUD average target sits below the ASX price. Many targets are set in NZD (MarketScreener NZX consensus NZ$46.77, Outperform), and TradingView's AUD figures match that consensus once converted.

HCW.brokers: Morgan Stanley, Bell Potter, Macquarie, Morgans
HCW.note: Most brokers are positive on the REIT. Morgan Stanley is the exception, with an Underweight rating and a target of about the current price (Sep 2026). FNArena's consensus target is A$0.90.

PGF.note: This listed investment company has no broker ratings or price targets. The only entries on TipRanks come from AI models and were ignored.

MVF.brokers: RBC Capital, Jefferies, Ord Minnett, Bell Potter, Morgans
MVF.note: The consensus leans Buy, but after the 2026 profit-guidance cut, targets were lowered to around A$0.70-0.85. RBC and Bell Potter rate it Hold.

CCP.brokers: Macquarie, Jefferies, Canaccord Genuity, J.P. Morgan, Morgans
CCP.note: The S&P Global consensus has 7 analysts: 5 Strong Buy, 1 Buy and 1 Hold. The latest target changes came after the August 2026 result. TradingView labels the consensus Buy, with a 17.72 average from 4 targets.

MEI.brokers: Macquarie, Canaccord Genuity, Ord Minnett, Bell Potter
MEI.note: Targets vary by site: TradingView averages 0.28, FNArena 0.34. Macquarie (0.43) and Canaccord (0.45) are the most bullish.

PWH.brokers: UBS, MA Financial, Bell Potter, Morgan Stanley, Morgans
PWH.note: A marginal Buy: MarketScreener and TradingView lean positive, but StockAnalysis shows Hold and several brokers cut to Hold in August 2026.

RG1.note: RG1 is a listed investment company holding a long/short portfolio of global listed securities, managed by Regal. Market Index says no major broker covers it, and TipRanks lists only AI-model ratings, which do not count.

AUC.note: Only two brokers: Canaccord Buy and Bell Potter Hold at 1.50. Sites quote Canaccord's target differently (3.00 vs 3.45), so the range is rough.

LSF.note: Listed long/short fund run by L1 Capital, with no broker targets found. Market Index showed the stock as halted or suspended.

SNL.note: Six analysts give a Buy consensus. Ord Minnett and MA Financial both kept Buy with 41.00 targets in late August 2026. TradingView's 4-target average is higher at 39.60.

WQG.note: WQG is a listed investment company investing in global equities. Market Index says no major broker covers it, and TipRanks shows only AI-model ratings.

XRF.note: Just two analysts cover XRF, and both are rated Strong Buy in the November 2026 period. TradingView's figures are almost the same, with a 2.30 average and a 2.26 to 2.34 range.
